CanonicalKeywords.rationale: `{ CardKeyword.Unplayable }` (Injury.cs:10) == `is_playable = False`. NOT Eternal and NOT Ethereal -- Injury is the plainest curse in the pool, removable and permanent in hand -- and the sim leaves both False. It also does NOT override CanBeGeneratedByModifiers, so Injury IS in the random-curse pool on both sides (the sim leaves the True default).

ctor.issue: CURSE / CURSE / NONE map exactly. The canonical energy cost is -1 in C# and 0 in the sim. `CardEnergyCost.GetWithModifiers` returns early on `_base < 0` (CardEnergyCost.cs:100-103), so the game's unplayable card is immune to every cost modifier; the sim runs a base of 0 through the full modifier chain (cards/base.py:222-232). Only what is READ diverges. Same mechanism and same verdict as card/ascenders_bane's ctor entry (rule 3). DORMANT: every ported cost reader filters `> 0` or skips `<= 1`, and events/infested_automaton.py:35 filters pool_card_ids(), which holds no curses or statuses.

OnPlay.rationale: Injury.cs has no members beyond the two overrides -- no OnPlay, no OnTurnEndInHand, no vars. A pure dead draw on both sides.

guards.what: the sim adds `is_unpowered = True` (injury.py:315), which has no counterpart in Injury.cs
guards.rationale: Inert: the flag only steers `DamageCmd.deal`'s prop inference and Injury deals no damage.
